title: Data on Persons with Autism Spectrum Disorder on Waitlist for Placement at Day Activity Centres
what_it_is: Data on Persons with Autism Spectrum Disorder on Waitlist for Placement at Day Activity Centres

sections.label: MSF DAC capacity increase
sections.summary: MSF is increasing DAC capacity by 500 places to meet demand, as announced in its 2024 Committee of Supply.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) is ramping up DAC capacity by 500 places to address the demand for DACs, as announced in MSF’s Committee of Supply in 2024.

sections.label: DAC wait times vary
sections.summary: Average wait time varies by DAC type, and in some larger ones with more facilities it can be up to five years or more.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuah Boon Theng (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: My understanding, though, is that average number or wait time, can vary widely depending on which type of DAC we are referring to.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuah Boon Theng (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: And in some of the larger ones with more facilities, I understand, that the wait time can be up to five years or more.

sections.label: DAC fee caps and costs
sections.summary: With fee caps introduced, families earning $2,800 or less have costs managed, but those earning more can pay up to $1,900.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuah Boon Theng (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: I know that there were announcements less than two years ago that with the fee caps introduced, families that earn $2,800 or less will have their costs managed.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuah Boon Theng (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: But those who earn more than $2,800 a month can pay up to $1,900.

sections.label: Private special education collaboration plans
sections.summary: The question asks whether there are plans to collaborate with private special education providers for young adults with ASD to add DAC places and extend subsidies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuah Boon Theng (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: The other question I have is, are there any plans to work and collaborate with private providers of special education for young adults with ASD, to explore if more places can be made available to address the short- to middle-term critical shortage of DAC places and possibly to extend subsidies to help more families afford those fees.

sections.label: Community living and support programmes
sections.summary: Pilots like the Enabled Living Programme, Home Support Programme, Enabling Services Hub and Enabling Skills for Life Programme provide community living options and integrate DAC and shelter workshop models.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: Pilots like the Enabled Living Programme, the Home Support Programme, which will start in the second half of this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: These provide community living options for persons with disabilities and special needs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: And then, there is the Enabling Services Hub (ESH), for which we have set up three across the island now.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: Because we are not dealing with a situation where there is a lack of services for persons with disabilities; rather, sometimes is that navigation of this quite complex landscape that is the issue.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: And also the Enabled Enabling Skills for Life Programme (ESLP) which is fundamentally a new service model that we are looking at which integrates the current DAC, as well as shelter workshop models to provide and equip persons with disabilities for independent living, for community participation, as well as for employability.

sections.label: DAC spaces increase by 2030
sections.summary: DAC spaces will increase by 500 over the next few years by 2030, with readiness to ramp up more if assessed need arises.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: As I mentioned, we will increase DAC spaces by 500 over the next few years by 2030; and we are prepared to ramp up even more if there is an assessed need to do so.
